name: semi-design
description: Semi brand builder for Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind 4: /semi-brand (brand kit and brand book), /semi-new-app (a product of the brand), /semi-check (check and fix an app), /semi-sync (new brand kit or Semi release); plus UI rules, lint hook and the docs MCP server (semi_search, semi_docs, semi_example, semi_block, semi_brand). Maintainers: /semi-propose, /semi-triage.
suggestedPrompts: Run /semi-brand in a brand repo to create or change a brand (logo, colours, fonts, voice, styles) and its brand book
Run /semi-new-app in an empty folder to create a new product of a brand
Run /semi-check in an existing app to check it against its brand and Semi, then fix it
Run /semi-sync in an app when its brand kit or Semi has a new release
Run /semi-propose to analyze project gaps and submit a feature request to Semi Design System
Run /semi-triage to evaluate and generalize incoming ecosystem issues
